digest.component_or_area: Architecture Decision Records / Reconciler Backend Seam
propositions: ADR 0035 requires amendment to document the jira_family abstraction layer inserted between the neutral core and concrete adapters, with two parameterizing contracts (RichTextCodec, UserIdentityModel) and the shared-jira provenance decision.

The TicketTransport protocol declares six members but the reconciler calls twenty-one distinct methods on transport, with twelve absent from DC implementation and declared on no Protocol, causing silent runtime failures in production code despite all contract and unit tests passing.

RemoteRef.instance is presented as the mechanism distinguishing deployments but is never constructed in production code (only in two test helpers), requiring the ADR to state it as intended design with the gap explicitly named and tracked.

ADR 0035's claim that the contract suite certifies a backend is conditional on the port being complete and typed, not merely declared; mypy cannot enforce completeness on an unannotated client parameter.
Jira Data Center transitions to read-only on March 28, 2029, framing this as a deliberately time-boxed, finite-duration investment in a durable family seam rather than perpetual adapter maintenance.

The documentation must be proven executable: the user-guide TOML configuration block must be parsed and executed against a live DC instance, and the guide must enforce the least-privilege, environment-only PAT security property at runtime.
